segments.sn52.5:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn52.5:1.3: “asekhenāvuso anuruddha, bhikkhunā katame dhammā upasampajja vihātabbā”ti?
segments.sn52.5:1.4: “Asekhenāvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā.
segments.sn52.5:1.6: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
segments.sn52.5:1.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ –
segments.sn52.5:1.10: asekhenāvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe sahassaṃ lokanti iminā therassa satata vihāro dassito.
Thero hi pātova mukhaṃ dhovitvā atītānāgate kappasahassaṃ anussarati.
Osadhibhāvāpekkhāya itthiliṅganiddeso, tabbahulatāya taṃ vanaṃ “kaṇḍakīvanan” teva paññāyittha.
Dasacakkavāḷasahassaṃ ekāvajjanassa āpāthaṃ āgacchati tathā ālokavaḍḍhanassa katattā.
